chunks: 97—What the Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me of, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud, from his father, from Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn al-Husayn and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf or someone else, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Abd Allah ibn Sinan, from one who informed him, from Abu Abd Allah عليه السلام, that he said:

Everything that is on a person or with him, among that in which salat cannot be validly performed by itself alone, then there is no problem in praying with it, even if there is filth on it, such as the cap, the belt-string, the waist-band, the sandal, the two leather socks, and whatever resembles that.

Then he said, may Allah the Exalted support him: If a person's garment falls upon the body of a deceased human being before it has been purified by ghusl, it renders it impure, and it becomes obligatory upon him to purify it with water. But if it falls upon it after its ghusl, that does not harm it, and salat in it is permissible for him even if he does not wash it.
That is indicated by the following.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: salat; the ritual prayer whose validity is being discussed
key_terms.الْخُفَّيْنِ: the two leather socks or foot-coverings mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.الْغُسْلِ: ritual washing by which the corpse is purified
key_terms.الْقَلَنْسُوَةِ: a cap or head-covering cited as an example of a small item
key_terms.قَذَرٌ: filth or impurity present on an item
key_terms.مَيِّتٍ: a dead person, specifically a human corpse in this context

ai.seo_question: Can one perform salat while carrying or wearing small impure items, and what happens if clothing touches a dead body?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on items that are too small or incidental to constitute a garment in which salat is performed independently, stating that prayer is not invalidated by impurity on such items. It also explains the ruling of a garment touching a human corpse, distinguishing between contact before and after the corpse has been purified by ghusl.
